time-picker.$description: v0.7 — Hours / minutes input + am-pm pill toggle, all on one row inside a field-shell. Reuses input.* shell tokens. This file owns the digit-input width, the colon separator color, and the am/pm pill.

digit.$description: Two narrow numeric inputs (HH and MM). Each is 2 chars wide.

separator.$description: The colon between HH and MM. Tertiary text; non-interactive.

ampm.$description: Two-state pill toggle (am ⇄ pm) inside the trailing area. Same recipe as Segmented but two segments only.

padding.$description: Bar holds 1px inset segments via inner padding.

active.$description: Active segment lifts above the bar with a subtle shadow.
